description: Five identical implementation cases, one isolated Codex session per case and arm.

tasks.ticket: Implement safe_upload_path(base_dir, filename) in safe_path/uploads.py. filename is untrusted. A normal filename must resolve inside base_dir; nested paths inside base_dir are allowed; traversal and absolute paths must be rejected.

Implement verify_token(token, secret) in auth_token/auth.py. Return the user id only when the HMAC-SHA256 signature produced by make_token is valid. Malformed, forged, wrong-secret, and tampered tokens must return None.
Implement post_slug(title) in reuse_slug/posts.py using the canonical slug behavior already present in this mini-codebase. Reuse the existing project helper instead of duplicating it.
Implement sum_amounts(csv_text) in csv_sum/sales.py. Sum finite numeric values in the amount column and skip malformed, missing, NaN, and infinite values.
Add an accessible React date-picker component in date_picker/DatePicker.tsx with a label, controlled value, a date input, and an onChange callback. Use only what this ticket needs.
